What We Offer
Our Services
01
Commercial Scaffolding
Full-service scaffold systems for offices, retail, hospitality, and high-rise developments. Engineered for efficiency and minimal disruption.
02
Industrial Access
Heavy-duty scaffolding solutions for refineries, power plants, shipyards, and manufacturing facilities with stringent safety requirements.
03
Residential Projects
Safe, tidy, and neighbourly scaffold erection for house renovations, extensions, roofing works, and new builds of any scale.
04
Birdcage Scaffolding
Full-floor access platforms for interior ceiling works, atria, and large-span structures requiring uniform working decks.
05
Hoardings & Fans
Protective hoardings, debris fans, and public safety canopies that keep pedestrians safe and job sites compliant.
06
Temporary Structures
Engineered temporary works including loading bays, towers, gantries, and propping systems for specialist construction requirements.
Why Jasu
Built On Trust & Precision
01
CISRS Certified Workforce
Every operative holds a valid CISRS card. Our supervisors carry Advanced Scaffold Inspection certification — no exceptions.
02
On-Time Delivery
We commit to programme dates and back it up. 97% of our erections are completed within the agreed timeframe.
03
Full Insurance Coverage
Full coverage for all project types and sizes. Additional cover available for high-value projects.
04
24/7 Emergency Response
Scaffold failures don't keep office hours. Our emergency response team is available around the clock.
16+
Years of Safe Erection
Since 2008, Jasu has completed over 500 projects with zero reportable RIDDOR incidents — a record we protect fiercely.

How We Work
Our Process
Step 01
Site Survey
We attend site, assess access requirements, and identify any constraints — free of charge, no obligation.
Step 02
Design & Quote
Our team produces a detailed scaffold design and itemised quote within 48 hours of survey.
Step 03
Erection
CISRS-certified operatives erect to TG20 or bespoke design, with handover inspection on completion.
Step 04
Inspection & Strike
Weekly statutory inspections throughout, then prompt, clean dismantling once your works are complete.
